mapper.select: SELECT sb.id, sb.sprint_id, s.sprint_name, p.product_name as productName, t.team_name as teamName, sb.product_backlog_id, pb.backlog_name as product_backlog_name, sb.team_member_id, tm.`name` as team_member_name, sb.backlog_title, sb.parent_id, sb.child_node, sb.backlog_status, CASE sb.backlog_status WHEN '1' THEN '未开始' WHEN '2' THEN '进行中' WHEN '3' THEN '已完成' ELSE '未知' END as backlog_status_name, sb.backlog_goal, sb.estimated_hours, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(dr.actual_hours) FROM scrum_development_records dr WHERE dr.sprint_backlog_id = sb.id), sb.actual_hours) as actual_hours, sb.backlog_description, sb.survey_id, sb.is_deleted, sb.create_time, sb.update_time, sb.creator, sb.updater FROM scrum_sprint_backlogs sb LEFT JOIN scrum_sprints s ON sb.sprint_id = s.id LEFT JOIN scrum_products p ON s.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN scrum_teams t ON s.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN scrum_product_backlogs pb ON sb.product_backlog_id = pb.id LEFT JOIN scrum_team_members tm ON sb.team_member_id = tm.id WHERE sb.is_deleted = 0 AND sb.sprint_id = #{sprintId} ORDER BY sb.create_time DESC, sb.id DESC
